channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Hurricane Hunters identify four signs a storm may strengthen
item.description: Nearly three decades of Hurricane Hunter data reveal four features that can help a tilted tropical cyclone straighten its circulation and intensify.

item.title: Tiny organism can shrink to a quarter of its size in milliseconds
item.description: A single-celled organism can shrink to one-quarter of its length in milliseconds using a calcium-powered protein fishnet, scientists say.

item.title: New chemical eliminates 95% of termites without harming humans
item.description: A chemical that prevents drywood termites from forming new exoskeletons killed about 95% of colonies in tests, offering a potentially safer option.

item.title: Deep-sea enzyme withstands heat that destroys most proteins
item.description: A deep-sea microbe uses a highly heat-resistant enzyme to convert atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia at temperatures that would destroy most proteins.
